name: Shirmani Employment Audit Closure
purpose: Define the evidence gates required before a work or income record can be treated as closed, reconciled, or publicly verified.
integrity_rules: CLOSED is not proof of payment unless payment evidence exists.
PAID is not proof of accounting reconciliation unless reconciliation evidence exists.
An open dispute blocks automatic closure.
Dispute resolution, contract interpretation, acceptance, refunds, reversals, liability, and identity questions require human review where applicable.
No fabricated settlement, reconciliation, completion, payment, income, refund, or resolution record.
Public verified totals must be derived from evidence-backed records rather than narrative claims.
AI-generated summaries, certificates, testimonials, profiles, or portfolio descriptions are not transaction evidence by themselves.

state_rules.OPEN: Work exists as an opportunity or active engagement route; closure is not established.
state_rules.COMPLETED: Completion evidence and acceptance evidence are present; payment remains a separate state.
state_rules.PAID: Payment evidence is present; reconciliation remains a separate state.
state_rules.RECONCILED: Payment and accounting/reconciliation evidence are present.
state_rules.CLOSED: Required lifecycle evidence is complete and no unresolved blocking dispute remains.
state_rules.NOT_VERIFIED: One or more required evidence gates are missing or cannot be independently established.
